consumed_diagnostics.finding: Question-independent TEMPURA-Qwen2.5-VL-3B dense captions missed the fine-grained AGQA entities and relations on the five consumed development queries.
Dense 48-of-64-frame GroundingDINO acquisition recovered all five gold entity labels but produced many low-confidence false detections, so label recall alone was insufficient.
High-resolution candidate-isolated Qwen-235B verification obtained 0.0526 supported precision, 0.2 gold supported recall, and 0.2 top-1 accuracy.

diagnosis: The remaining error is annotation-aligned object-relation grounding, not generic caption generation or source-induced symbolic execution.

method_change_under_development.route: Frozen pretrained Action-Genome-native SGDET model over raw sampled frames, exporting predicted objects and attention/spatial/contact relations into the existing shared typed receipt.
method_change_under_development.implementation: Official TEMPURA/unbiasedSGG prediction-only SGDET path at git commit 976babd45f1d14f6d7386188e9265507cf0f07dc.
method_change_under_development.vendor_runtime_patch: Removed a committed unconditional debug exit() and adjacent diagnostic prints from lib/transformer.py; no tensor operation, weight, threshold, or model decision was changed.

overlap_policy.consumed_current_five_video_pilot: Engineering development only; it is not admissible evidence because Action Genome pretraining-video overlap has not yet been excluded.
overlap_policy.qualification: Must use videos proven disjoint from the pretrained SGDET training split.
overlap_policy.formal: Must additionally be disjoint from development and all previously consumed AGQA reserves.

pending_before_method_freeze: Run prediction-only SGDET on raw frames without loading any per-video annotation artifact.
Measure entity and typed relation fidelity only after each development receipt is frozen.
Audit Action Genome training-video overlap and construct a disjoint development qualification cohort.
Do not allocate a new formal reserve unless every unchanged qualification gate passes.
